description: An awareness episode of about 15 minutes for all staff. On an authorised exercise at Quayholt Insurance, a fictional company, you first play the attacker: research what's public, build a look-alike sign-in page, and send one email carrying its link. Then you swap seats and check the pages that land behind links in a Quayholt inbox. Only the inbox check is scored, and reporting when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down.
